nodes.label: pnpm workspace (packages/*, apps/*)
nodes.rationale: Single workspace covering packages/* and apps/*, sharing one lock file.

nodes.label: Native dependency build allowlist (nx, onnxruntime-node, protobufjs, sharp)
nodes.rationale: onnxruntime is the wake word and the voice; sharp and protobufjs come along with them. pnpm blocks install scripts unless they are named here and stopped reading the list from package.json in version 10. Both allowBuilds (current spelling) and onlyBuiltDependencies (older) are listed so whichever pnpm is on the machine agrees.
